requestKey: What is the best AI stylist app?|cherly.app|sample0

payload.text:
Short answer: “Best” depends on what you want the stylist to do. Here are strong, current picks by goal:

- Style what you already own (closet-first, free-friendly): Acloset. Digitize your wardrobe, get AI outfit ideas, and use Style Chat; recent updates added color/fit analysis and expanded shop-imports. iOS/Android. ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/acloset-ai-fashion-assistant/id1542311809?utm_source=openai))
- Closet + social inspiration: Whering. A “social wardrobe” with styling tools and community looks. iOS/Android. ([whering.co](https://www.whering.co/?utm_source=openai))
- Color/body/style analysis with daily outfits: Style DNA. Emphasizes personal color and body-type profiling plus AI-styled daily looks. iOS/Android. ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/style-dna-ai-color-analysis/id1358319821?utm_source=openai))
- Capsule wardrobe planning and weather-aware outfits: Cladwell. Capsule-focused app; shows daily recommendations and now touts AI-assisted advice. iOS/Android. ([cladwell.com](https://cladwell.com/app?utm_source=openai))
- Quick AI outfit maker + chat: Pronti. Closet-aware outfit generator with an in-app AI stylist (PAI). iOS/Android. ([pronti.com](https://www.pronti.com/outfit-maker-with-your-clothes/?utm_source=openai))
- If you want new pieces shipped, not just advice: Stitch Fix pairs algorithms and human stylists; added GenAI-assisted tools in 2025. US-focused. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stitch_Fix?utm_source=openai))

How to choose fast
- Will you photograph your clothes? If not, pick shopping-first options (e.g., Stitch Fix). If yes, closet-first apps (Acloset, Whering, Cladwell, Pronti) shine.
- Must-have features: weather/context-aware outfits, color/body analysis, or community inspiration.
- Cost and data: check free tiers and what photos or purchase data you’ll share in each app’s settings.

Tell me:
1) Do you want outfits from your own closet, new shopping recommendations, or both?
2) iOS or Android, and any budget limits?
I’ll narrow it to one or two “best for you” picks.
